This reinforces sequence and helps distinguish when changes occurred, improving retention of temporal details.

By organizing the content into these clusters, you can mentally navigate the document more efficiently and reinforce connections between different parts.

##Use the "before and after" contrast to understand the merger  
The document explicitly states that the 2020 merger between the Ludwig Mond Award and the Nyholm Prize created a new prize. Highlight this transformation by creating a side-by-side comparison: before (two separate awards) vs. after (one combined prize). This contrast strengthens memory by emphasizing a pivotal change and its implications.
